title: 955. Delete Columns to Make Sorted II

examples.explanation: After deleting the first column, strs = ["a", "b", "c"]. Now strs is in lexicographic order (ie. strs[0] <= strs[1] <= strs[2]). We require at least 1 deletion since initially strs was not in lexicographic order, so the answer is 1.

strs is already in lexicographic order, so we do not need to delete anything. Note that the rows of strs are not necessarily in lexicographic order: i.e., it is NOT necessarily true that (strs[0][0] <= strs[0][1] <= ...)
We have to delete every column.
